startSession: Read the handoff file referenced by latestHandoff.
Continue from the newest user goal and respect dirty worktree notes.
endSession: Update handoffs/LATEST.json to point at the new handoff.
Include current goal, work completed, files changed, verification, git status, known issues, next steps, and do-not-revert notes.

notes: Use docs/ for durable architecture and design references.
Use handoffs/ for short-lived session state.
Do not duplicate long docs inside handoffs; link or reference them.
